name: Shigure Umbrellas
description: A quiet store theme for a small umbrella atelier on a riverside shopping street, making and mending traditional and compact umbrellas by hand, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Rain-mist pages, slate panels, ink text and one muted steel accent; Ibarra Real Nova for reading and display, Golos Text for labels and rib counts. The wordmark sits centred between two tiny ferrule tip marks with the menu split three left and three right on a pale mist bar, a cool steel hairline beneath (H2); the home page opens with one quiet line (Umbrellas for the quiet rain) and then the canopy rail, a slow sideways scroll-snap track of opened umbrellas in large round canopy cells with their rib count and width in small type, keyboard and touch scrollable (L4); then the atelier note, the synced repair promise, a size-guide teaser drawn as concentric canopy rings, and the journal. The footer leads with a rain letter sign-up on a deep slate band, with shop details and slim links below (F4). Care & repair, Size guide, The workshop, journal, newsletter and contact. The shop address, hours, telephone and email, and the repair terms, each live in one synced pattern (WooCommerce optional: without it the rail shows static canopies and orders go by email).
deviation: Codes: none (H2 + F4 + L4 as planned; combination unused: Kuyuru Incense H2/F1/L12, Kura Shizuku H2/F3/L7, Komugi Pan H2/F8/L11, Sakura Juku H2/F11/L6, Nameshi Leather H2/F10/L14; Kumo Eyewear H6/F4/L14, Eda Bonsai H11/F4/L13, Hana Kago H8/F4/L8, Oto Radio H5/F4/L12; Amane Wagashi H5/F6/L4, Kinu Kimono H11/F8/L4, Kiroku Studio H12/F1/L4). Palette as planned (mist #E9ECEF, slate #D3D9DF, ink #23303B, muted steel #5E7489) with added colours, all AA-checked (WCAG 2.x): ink is 11.4:1 on mist, 9.5:1 on slate and 12.6:1 on pale mist #F5F7F8; muted steel #5E7489 is only 4.1:1 on mist and 3.4:1 on slate, so it is used only for large display italics, ferrule and tip marks, canopy rings and hairlines, never for small text; deep steel #3F5263 was added for links, labels and rib counts (6.8:1 mist, 5.7:1 slate, 7.5:1 pale mist); quiet slate #4E5A66 for secondary text (6.0:1 mist, 5.0:1 slate, 6.6:1 pale mist); steel hairline #B4C0CB is decorative only; pale mist #F5F7F8 for cards. Buttons are ink with mist text (11.4:1). The F4 band is deep slate #23303B (the ink) with mist text (11.4:1) and muted labels #B4C0CB (7.3:1), chosen over a #D3D9DF band so the footer reads as one quiet dark band under airy pages. H2 differs from Komugi (warm flour), Kuyuru (wisteria), Nameshi (stitched parchment) and Sakura (pink pill): cool mist bar, one steel hairline, tiny CSS ferrule tip marks either side of the wordmark; account and cart sit in the right cluster when WooCommerce is active; below 1180px the menu becomes a Menu button and the wordmark stays centred on one line at 390px. L4 differs from Kinu (framed kimono rack), Kiroku (kinetic reel) and Amane (seasonal tray months): large round canopy cells with faint radial rib lines, no autoplay or motion, scroll-snap with keyboard focus. F4 differs from Kumo (cool grey technical), Eda (lichen letter), Hana (Monday stem letter) and Oto (amber band): a centred rain letter on deep slate with the ferrule mark. Fonts verified against google/fonts OFL.txt (2026-10-13): Ibarra Real Nova and Golos Text are OFL-1.1 with no Reserved Font Name, so both ship as Latin WOFF2 subsets (Ibarra Real Nova Roman weights 400-600, Italic 400-500, Golos Text 400-500). Ibarra Real Nova has no tabular-figure feature, so prices use its lining figures and the rib counts, table cells and step numbers use Golos Text tabular figures. Added a newsletter page because check-themes requires it; industry umbrellas and page tags care-repair and size-guide are new (The workshop uses the about tag).
